title: Parsing Push Notification Payloads
hints: Try decoding `alert` as a `String` first, then as a nested container.
Map `content-available` with a custom `CodingKeys` raw value.
Silent = `content-available == 1` with no title or body.
jsBridge: Push payloads are JSON with a reserved `aps` dictionary plus your custom keys. Decoding them with `Codable` is like typing a Web Push payload, but Apple defines the `aps` part (alert, badge, sound, content-available).

compass.q: Web Push payloads are free-form. Which parts of an APNs payload does iOS interpret for you?
Silent pushes (`content-available: 1`): are they guaranteed to wake the app? (No, they're throttled.) Why?
Alert push vs silent push vs Notification Service Extension (mutable-content): which can modify the message?
Deep-linking from a tapped notification: where do you read the payload and route?
